transcript.text: Build a VS Code extension that turns an idea into a TUTORIAL instead of a vibecoded app. Inspired by repo-tour: where repo-tour digests an existing repo and walks you through how it works, this walks you through how to BUILD one — paint-by-numbers app creation. It teaches the DECISIONS behind why a file/repo is shaped the way it is, step by step.

Greenfield, empty folder /home/corgea/Desktop/Coding Projects/VSCode-LLM-Tutorial, not yet a git repo. Sibling project repo-tour (same parent dir) is the conceptual sibling/inverse and the source of this shop's AutoDev config. Evan explicitly said: take AutoDev settings from repo-tour.

TWO MODES, confirmed by Evan 2026-09-04: (A) PLAN-FIRST + SOCRATIC — bring an idea, it builds from first principles and simple shapes, asking him about each decision as it goes. (B) EXEMPLAR — point it at a real repo; at each decision he chooses to FOLLOW the repo author's decision or DIVERGE with his own. Evan asked the PM to shape this into a spec with him.

SPEC SHAPE, Evan 2026-09-04: (1) Opening window: idea textbox + checkbox 'simply recreate the repo as it stands' + repo field (optional; required when that checkbox is ticked). (2) A THREE-POSITION DIAL for who writes code: fully manual / boilerplate-scaffolded / automated (it builds, you watch). (3) A TUTOR available at every step, modelled on sql-gauntlet's context-keyed chat drawer — repo-tour needs this too (filed there as T-10). (4) A concept DETOUR (Evan's working name was a joke he asked NOT to be over-indexed on): when a concept doesn't land, leave the build, demonstrate it on a completely unrelated toy example built together, then return.

DECISION Evan 2026-09-04 — DIVERGENCE = REPLAN THE REMAINDER. When the user diverges from the reference repo's decision at step N, the un-walked steps are thrown out and re-derived from the new decision (a Mode-A replan seeded by the Mode-B prefix). Evan explicitly accepted the cost of the plan changing under him: 'The cost doesn't really bother me honestly... that seems like sophistication that we don't need yet. So let's replan the remainder so we get something that functions. If we start selling this or something then maybe.' => a visible replan diff is a LATER concern, not v1. Also: GitHub repo is https://github.com/BMA-Corgea/VSCode-LLM-Tutorial, license AGPL.
